svg.desc: The NFT is on mainnet. Gear and records are on testnet, under the same token id. MAINNET Trenchie NFT Identity + owner TESTNET Inventory + record Gear earned in fights Fight history Predictions Same identity Whoever owns the NFT controls the Trenchie and its gear.
